project.name: job-portal
project.productType: Job search and application tracking web app
stack: Vanilla CSS and JavaScript (no build step)

patterns: Dashboard shell: sticky white header, white sidebar with soft-indigo active item and left accent bar
Segmented tabs for Career Ops and application views
Soft status pills (green/amber/red) with dark text for AA contrast

must: Keep token names in :root (--bg-card, --accent-brand, --text-muted, ...) because script-rendered markup and careerops.css depend on them
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)
No build step: plain CSS, no framework
avoid: Pastel avatar colours with white initials

decisions.decision: Light, professional theme: slate neutrals, white surfaces on a soft grey canvas, one indigo accent, 8-12px radii, solid buttons.
decisions.reason: Requested by the user (light theme, professional). Patterns referenced from 21st dashboard-shell, joined stat card and segmented tab components, re-implemented in plain CSS because the portal has no React or Tailwind build.

evidence: Contrast audit: 1,584 text elements across 12 screens, 0 failures after darkening --text-faint to #5b6b80
Overflow audit: no horizontal scroll on 9 screens at 320, 360, 400, 768 and 1280px
